title: Routine: practices in sequence, run end to end by the hands-off player (sit/)
description: PRACTICE-ENGINE §1 Routine layer. Each item is a built practice (practices/<id>.json) fitted to its minutes by sit/session.mjs fitPractice: longer = the practice's own rounds then silent open sitting (rule open-sitting); shorter = beginner form, then optional stages dropped. Never a hold: practices with retention are refused.

only_stages.description: run only these stages (e.g. the settling steps of a longer method)
